Appearance now shows illustrated System, Light and Dark theme choices. The existing Pixel texture also works with the Transparent window background, keeping the desktop blur live.

Message attribution shows a compact local date and 24-hour time after the author. The date disappears before the author's name truncates when space is tight; full timestamps remain in the context menu. Reply actions use Hugeicons ArrowTurnBackward.

Bundles gateway 0.16.33 (protocol 93), unchanged from 0.10.8. Build 25.
